searchResults.jobSummary: We are looking for a physicist, electro-optical engineer, or computational-photonics researcher to join our growing Advanced Optics team in Herzliya. The Apple Camera Hardware Engineering group is responsible for research, design, development, test, and qualification of camera hardware for Apple products; our team owns the end-to-end design, production, and testing of high-quality micro- and nano-optic components, including diffractive elements and metasurfaces. The environment is collaborative and hands-on, fostering engineering excellence and creativity across the interdisciplinary boundary of optical design, numerical simulation, optimization, and semiconductor fabrication methods.
searchResults.postingTitle: Advanced Optics Design Engineer — Camera HW

searchResults.jobSummary: We are looking for an electro-optics test engineer to join our growing Advanced Optics team in Herzliya. The Apple Camera Hardware Engineering group is responsible for the design, development, test, and qualification of camera hardware for Apple products; our team owns the end-to-end design, production, and testing of high-quality micro- and nano-optic components, including diffractive elements and metasurfaces. In this role you will own how we measure those components — developing new optical test setups, characterizing performance against design intent, and defining the metrology that carries a component from first prototype to mass production. The environment is collaborative and hands-on, spanning optical design, numerical simulation, precision measurement, and semiconductor fabrication.
searchResults.postingTitle: Optical Characterization Lead Engineer — Camera HW

searchResults.jobSummary: The technologies within Apple's Core Location are fundamental in enabling location-aware experiences for users across all platforms. Our customers rely on fast and accurate location for many of their most important daily needs, and they trust us with some of the most sensitive data their devices can produce. As a Senior Systems Software Engineer within the Location Team, you will help shape how our systems come together across hardware, firmware, and software, and you will build them yourself. If you are an experienced engineer who wants to design a system and then write the code that brings it to life, we may be the team for you.

The Camera System Engineering team, in collaboration with multiple HW and SW teams, is responsible for the systems-level analysis, simulation and optimization of new camera HW and SW to achieve the best camera performance from the hardware level through to the user facing applications. The team is seeking an exceptional systems engineer with broad skills to take a leading role in the x-functional activity. The ideal candidate would have the capabilities required to perform detailed system analysis and tradeoff evaluations while also driving and collaborating with cross functional teams.

We are looking for an outstanding graduate student to join our Advanced Optics team in Herzliya on a part-time basis alongside their studies. The Apple Camera Hardware Engineering group owns the end-to-end design, production, and testing of high-quality micro- and nano-optic components, including diffractive elements and metasurfaces. You will work closely with an experienced, interdisciplinary team spanning optical design, numerical simulation, optimization, and semiconductor fabrication.
